comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This item seems to be a special event-only reward and CANNOT be created via Transmutation Alchemy. The event in question ran on Japanese servers, but the likelihood of it coming to Maris is... probably low.

EX Effect: Increase trade goods purchase R3

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?LiveEvent/ARTE (event data), yukimiiro.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-435.html (event data/screenshots)
